data.title: Rejection of electric wheelchair application (Elektrorollstuhl)
data.summary: Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse rejects Bastian Musterquell's application for an electric wheelchair, offering a wheelchair with a pushing aid (Schiebehilfe) for a companion instead, based on a Medical Service (Medizinischer Dienst) assessment. The letter, dated 20 November 2026, explains the right to file an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: Your health insurance has turned down your request for an electric wheelchair, saying an assessment found you can manage short indoor distances with a rollator, and approved a pushchair-type wheelchair for longer trips instead. If you disagree, you have the right to file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the insurer; the app will show you the deadline. You can also go in person and have the objection recorded there. If you do nothing by the deadline shown, this decision becomes final. Since this concerns a mobility aid important to daily life, consider getting advice (e.g. from a patient advocacy group or lawyer) if you want to contest it.
